sources.fullCitation: Orchester Barnabas von Géczy, refrain sung by Hans Emmé-Schuhardt. “Wer weiß, wer weiß, ob du mich noch liebst (I'm sure).” The upload gives no label, catalogue or matrix number and does not show the disc; the title appears in a fuller form than the one under which the song is registered here. Published on YouTube by Grammophonics – 78Upm. Accessed 20 August 2026.
